text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you check the weekly weather 
forecast?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Now we can go without having to worry 
about anything.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is there anything you'd like to 
do on our trip?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is a celebration. Though my main 
goal is just having fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her words, I took out a "certain 
item" I had spent the last few days 
putting together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hm? Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! That distinct aroma. It really feels 
like an authentic hot spring town!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's finally time for that map 
you made to shine, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An onsen manju map made for Bubble Gum 
Fellow, who has a massive sweet tooth. I 
thought it'd serve as a handy guide for 
touring the shops, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that, I decided on something for 
this trip, you know."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—I'm going to conquer every onsen manju on 
the map!
choice_data_list:
Actually... that was my intention all 
along!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Looks like we ended up with the 
same goal again!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! Today's a celebration, so we've 
gotta enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That manju just now had such a rich 
flavor~. You could really tell how much 
care went into the red beans.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how was it?
choice_data_list: Now THAT was the taste of a true manju!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Their selling point seemed to 
be that it's made using traditional 
methods.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Our hot spring steamed bun tour got off 
to a start with the absolute best flavor♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, moving on to the next one already? 
Let's see, next is... the rich and fluffy 
onsen manju with that extra creamy milk 
batter, right!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"That's the 5th shop down. That was so 
good~ My whole mouth is full of 
happiness!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still... that shop from earlier, to think 
a single manju had seven different 
flavors.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is your stomach feeling okay?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Don't force yourself! As long as I can 
finish it, that counts as clearing it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"After all, the two of us have walked... 
no, run side by side this whole time!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! ...Oh, there's a rest area 
over there. Let's go digest our food for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just walking looks painful for you... 
Here, take a seat, sit down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We take breaks here and there along our 
hot spring bun tour. Though at this point, 
the eating is entirely left to Bubble Gum 
Fellow..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My stomach feels heavy. With every step I 
take, it feels like taking a direct hit to 
the gut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, it took longer than 
planned. At this rate, even by the time 
the shop closes, conquering it will be...
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I might not be able to conquer it 
today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Bubble Gum Fellow is the type to follow 
through once he gives his word. It feels 
like I ended up holding him back."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"By today? The trip continues tomorrow 
anyway, so there's no problem."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —And besides...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush. Take it easy, go 
slow... enjoying the moment with the 
occasional break or detour.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Because that's what I decided.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Come on, get some solid rest! The hot 
springs are waiting after this. Let's work 
up a good sweat and get ready for 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I enjoyed sightseeing and visiting plenty 
of shops with an excited Bubblegum Fellow. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Whew! That bath felt amazing! So 
refreshing, right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
When all's said and done, we managed to 
see quite a bit just today, so—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow morning we'll take it easy, and 
in the afternoon we'll finish the rest of 
the manju... Something like that?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow laughs at that, leaving 
me tilting my head in bewilderment.
choice_data_list: What made you decide to take it easy?
What made you decide to take it easy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was a strange question to ask while on 
a hot spring trip, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if it were her, she would 
prioritize the objective first.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, it's nothing major, but let's 
see..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I got a little lightheaded from the bath. 
Wanna cool off in the night breeze and 
chat?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Feels nice. It's pretty chilly, but 
right now it feels just right.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“...... I've really wanted to just relax 
and take it easy like this~.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember our goal this time? It's 
to 'have fun.'

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...And besides, you know.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"We've been running non-stop all the way 
up to today, haven't we?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...To become a strong Umamusume capable of 
changing the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: In order to raise that kind of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I've been running with all my might, 
without even a moment to look back.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's not that I don't have any 
memories, okay? I just meant I made it all 
the way here without even having time to 
look back fondly.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"So, yeah. Just like today, a time where 
we can relax—neither chasing nor being 
chased."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to enjoy it together with 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Because I am once again—
choice_data_list:
...Is it because you're starting to run 
again?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yup! As expected, you get it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I won't stop. I can't afford to stop. 
...Because the strongest is always the one 
being chased.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"If they caught up too easily, then all 
the hype and excitement would just fizzle 
out, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's running must have sent 
shockwaves through many. And surely, it 
will continue to do so—
choice_data_list:
The racing world is only going to get more 
exciting from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm going to get stronger and 
stronger. And bring even more change to 
the racing world than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So... from now on, to the very ends of the 
earth. Watch over me until the end, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Bubble Gum 
Fellow and myself...
